name: RAG-IGBench
description: RAG-IGBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate interleaved generation based on retrieval-augmented generation in open-domain question answering. It integrates multimodal large language models with retrieval mechanisms to generate coherent multimodal content and introduces innovative evaluation metrics measuring text and image quality and their consistency.
evaluation_method: human correlation validated metrics for text and image quality and consistency
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest to researchers working on multimodal RAG and interleaved generation.
notes: Draws on latest publicly available social platform content; includes training set improving model performance.
